skill.name: agentpostage
skill.description: Send PDF documents as paid US mail through AgentPostage, with pricing, status, balance, tracking, cancellation, and receipt support.
skill.summary: Mail authorized PDFs through AgentPostage and monitor each paid delivery request.
skill.author: ctxrs

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by JavaScript template literals, Markdown formatting, validation expressions, and documented credential configuration. The CLI does make authenticated network requests, and semantic review found high-risk origin redirection and paid-mail execution concerns.

remediation.issue: A custom HTTPS base URL receives the API key and may receive private mail data.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict production requests to agentpostage.com. Permit overrides only for loopback tests, and never attach production credentials to an override origin.

remediation.issue: A send can spend funds and trigger automatic recharge without a final transaction confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation immediately before sending. Show recipient, service, print options, current price, and automatic recharge status.

remediation.issue: PDFs and postal addresses are transferred to an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Display the destination and retention policy before upload. Minimize local copies and remove temporary address files after completion.

content.user_title: Send PDFs as Trackable US Mail
content.value_statement: Preparing and tracking physical mail manually takes time and creates duplicate-send risks. This skill prices, submits, and monitors authorized PDF mail through AgentPostage.
actual_capabilities: Checks account balance and current mailing prices.
Sends an existing PDF to a US recipient address.
Supports First-Class, Certified, return receipt, flat, and HSE services.
Configures color, duplex printing, paper, and reply envelopes.
Retrieves letter status, transaction history, tracking, and available receipts.
Cancels eligible letters and preserves idempotency during recovery.
limitations: Requires a verified AgentPostage account, funded balance, and API key.
Supports US sender and recipient addresses only.
Cannot guarantee legal sufficiency, mailing dates, delivery dates, or successful cancellation.
Source PDFs must satisfy service page limits and a 10 MiB size limit.

use_cases.title: Send Account Disputes
use_cases.description: Mail an authorized dispute PDF with a chosen service and preserve the resulting letter record.
use_cases.target_user: Consumers managing bank or credit disputes

use_cases.title: Deliver Cancellation Notices
use_cases.description: Price and send cancellation documents with tracking or an electronic return receipt.
use_cases.target_user: Customers ending subscription or membership agreements

use_cases.title: Monitor Operational Mail
use_cases.description: Review queued letters, transaction costs, delivery status, and available receipts.

prompt_templates.title: Check Mailing Price
prompt_templates.prompt: Price this [page count]-page PDF using [service]. Use black ink, single-sided white paper, and no reply envelope.
prompt_templates.scenario: Estimate cost before preparing a mailing.

prompt_templates.title: Send an Authorized PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Send [PDF path] from [sender address file] to [recipient address file] using [service]. Confirm the final details and price before submission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Submit one approved document for physical delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Track a Letter
prompt_templates.prompt: Check letter [letter ID]. Report its exact status, charged cost, tracking evidence, and receipt availability without inferring delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Recover an Uncertain Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate the timed-out send for [letter details]. Search existing letters first, preserve the idempotency key, and avoid duplicate mail.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve an advanced failure without creating a second mailing.

output_examples.input: Price a three-page First-Class letter with default print options.
output_examples.output: Estimated price: 142 cents. Service: First-Class. Printing: black, single-sided, white paper. This price does not reserve the rate.

output_examples.input: Send the approved cancellation letter and report the result.
output_examples.output: The letter was queued successfully. Letter ID: 8d31... Service: First-Class. Charged cost: 142 cents. Queued does not mean mailed.

output_examples.input: Check whether my Certified letter was delivered.
output_examples.output: Current status: delivered. Tracking confirms delivery. An electronic receipt is available through the authenticated AgentPostage account.

best_practices: Confirm authority, recipient, service, print options, and current price immediately before sending.
Preserve one idempotency key and identical inputs until each submission outcome is known.
Protect PDFs, addresses, letter identifiers, and receipts as private user data.
anti_patterns: Do not invent signatures, addresses, facts, deadlines, or document content.
Do not retry an uncertain send with a new idempotency key.
Do not treat queued, accepted, or a cancellation attempt as proof of completion.

faq.question: Does a price check send my PDF?
faq.answer: No. Pricing uses the page count and print options without uploading or storing the PDF.

faq.question: Which addresses are supported?
faq.answer: The skill requires a US return address and a US recipient address.

faq.question: Can it send Certified Mail?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Certified Mail and Certified Mail with an electronic return receipt.

faq.question: How does it prevent duplicate mail?
faq.answer: It preserves one idempotency key and reuses identical inputs after uncertain results.

faq.question: Does queued mean mailed?
faq.answer: No. Queued means the request was saved for processing. Check later status for confirmed mailing or delivery.

faq.question: Can the skill charge my card?
faq.answer: The key spends the account balance. A send may trigger automatic recharge when the account owner enabled it.
